name: Tanvir Ahmed
bio: Roommates during our CSE years at Dhaka University. Still argue about which of us codes faster, and we've never settled it.

name: Rafiul Karim
bio: Runs a components distributor in Chattogram. Good source for bulk laptop charger stock and always tips me off on price drops first.

name: Nusrat Jahan
bio: Lives two houses down in Lakshmipur. Our mothers are close, and she still drops by with mishti whenever she visits home.

name: Shakil Hossain
bio: First cousin, grew up next door before his family moved to Dhaka. We used to fly kites off the rooftop every Eid.

name: Imran Kabir
bio: My badminton partner at the local club, three evenings a week. Fiercely competitive and never lets me win, even once.

name: Mahmuda Akter
bio: Wholesale contact in Dhaka's electronics market who sources gadgets and lighting fixtures for the shop at fair prices.

name: Farhan Chowdhury
bio: Best friend from secondary school, now working in Kuala Lumpur. We promised to video call monthly but keep missing each other's time zones.

name: Ovi Rahman
bio: Met in a Valorant lobby three years ago and never stopped queuing together. Lives in Sylhet, we've still never met in person.
